sloka: भरतो नाम कैकेय्याम् जज्ञे सत्य पराक्रमः ।साक्षात् विष्णोः चतुर्थ भागः सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः ॥१-१८-१३॥
transliteration: bharato nāma kaikeyyām jajñe satya parākramaḥ ।sākṣāt viṣṇoḥ caturtha bhāgaḥ sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ ॥1-18-13॥

translations.english: Sumitra gave birth to Lakshmana and Satrughna who were heroic, skilled in the use of all weapons and endowed with the facets of Visnu.
